reports.evidence: Key had an empty entry and "B"; solver and solution both give B, so answer key format is wrong.
reports.student_reply: Hi! You’re right – the correct option is B (≈1.44 min). The answer key was stored as a two‑item array ["","B"] which made the app think it was a multiple‑correct question. We’ve fixed it to just ["B"], so you’ll see B as the single correct answer now.
